about: The secreta of the formulary “2nd Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the sacrifice we are about to offer unto Your holy Name, O Lord, make us pure, and day by day help us to live a more heavenly life. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
